'''Newry City Athletic Football Club''', referred to as '''Newry City''', are a semi-professional [[Northern Ireland|Northern Irish]] [[association football|football]] club competing in the [[NIFL Championship]], having been promoted from the [[NIFL Premier Intermediate League]] in May 2026. They also compete in the [[Irish Cup]].
The club is based in [[Newry]], [[County Down]] and plays at the [[The Showgrounds (Newry)|Showgrounds]] on the south eastern outskirts of the city. Newry City are a part of the [[Mid-Ulster F.A.|Mid-Ulster Football Association]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Mid Ulster Football Association |url=https://midulsterfa.co.uk/ |access-date=2025-12-03 |website=midulsterfa.co.uk}}</ref> The club's colours are blue and white, with the jersey ordinarily employing blue and white vertical stripes."}}
